vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: duhui-all-to-pdf
Version: 1.0.1

The skill converts local documents to PDF using the Duhui API on Alibaba Cloud. The core script (scripts/duhui_doc_to_pdf.py) fetches temporary OSS credentials from duhuitech.com, uploads the document to a vendor-managed Alibaba OSS bucket, and polls an async API for the converted file. While this involves sending user data to a third-party service, the behavior is explicitly documented in SKILL.md and references/doc_to_pdf_ali.md as the intended workflow. The code uses only Python standard libraries, handles secrets via environment variables, and includes best-effort cleanup of remote temporary files.

llm.summary: The skill largely implements a doc->PDF flow (uploads a local file to vendor OSS, calls the Duhui async API, polls results), but there are important inconsistencies and privacy/credential handling risks you should understand before installing.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md and the included Python script require an environment variable DUHUI_ALI_APPCODE and runtime Python, but the registry metadata lists no required env vars or required binaries — this mismatch is unexplained. The code uploads user files to a vendor-controlled OSS bucket and then calls Alibaba Cloud Market convert_async, which is coherent with the stated purpose, but the missing declaration of DUHUI_ALI_APPCODE and runtime dependency on python3 is an inconsistency.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions direct the agent to run the bundled Python script which will (a) fetch temporary OSS upload credentials from https://file.duhuitech.com/k/tmp_up.json, (b) upload the local file to fmtmp.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com, (c) call the Duhui async API and poll https://api.duhuitech.com/q, then download the PDF. These network actions will transmit the user's local file to third-party storage (vendor-controlled). That behavior matches the stated conversion purpose but is a significant data-exfiltration/privacy action that must be explicit to the user and declared in metadata.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only), which minimizes supply-chain risk. However the runtime requires python3 (SKILL.md shows running python3 scripts/duhui_doc_to_pdf.py) while registry metadata lists no required binaries — another metadata omission to fix. The script uses only the Python standard library (no external packages) so no extra packages are pulled in.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill needs a single secret-like env var (DUHUI_ALI_APPCODE) to call the Alibaba Market API, which is proportionate — but that env var is not declared in the registry metadata. Additionally, the script fetches temporary OSS credentials from a remote URL (file.duhuitech.com) at runtime and uses them to upload user files to the vendor bucket. Requesting and using those remote credentials is operationally reasonable for this flow but increases blast radius (third-party endpoints and stored files).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent presence (always:false) and does not modify other skills or global agent configs. Temporary OSS credentials are cached only in-process; the skill does not persist secrets to disk by itself.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, note three things: (1) Metadata is incomplete — the skill requires DUHUI_ALI_APPCODE and python3 at runtime but those are not declared; ask the publisher to fix the metadata. (2) Using the skill uploads your local file to vendor-owned OSS (fmtmp.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com) and obtains temporary upload credentials from https://file.duhuitech.com/k/tmp_up.json — verify you trust file.duhuitech.com / duhuitech and understand retention/visibility of uploaded files. The script attempts to delete temporary objects but deletion can fail and files may persist briefly. (3) Do not paste AppCode into chat; inject it into the agent environment via your secret store. If the document contains sensitive data, prefer an offline/local converter or confirm the vendor's data retention and access policies first. If you need higher assurance, request the publisher to (a) declare DUHUI_ALI_APPCODE and python3 in the skill metadata, (b) document tmp_up.json ownership and rotation policy, and (c) provide a way to run with a user-controlled OSS bucket or signed upload endpoint so files never land on vendor-controlled storage.
